tagline: An industrial investment company exercising active ownership to create value
hero_kpi_rationale: Net Asset Value (NAV) is the primary performance indicator for Aker, reflecting the true value of its portfolio of strategic businesses and financial investments. It is the central driver of shareholder value creation in this industrial holding model.
company_description: Aker ASA is an industrial investment company exercising active ownership in businesses focused on energy, digitalization, marine biotechnology, and asset management. It creates value through long-term strategic and operational engagement.

kpis.name: Net Asset Value
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets after liabilities, key to measuring the company's financial health.
kpis.description: NAV declined in 2024, falling from 63.2 to 58.2 billion NOK, impacted by lower portfolio valuations.
kpis.signal: Core fundamental value metric for an industrial holding

kpis.name: Gross Asset Value
kpis.explanation: Total gross value of investments before liabilities.
kpis.description: GAV decreased in 2024, from 72.1 to 65.4 billion NOK, due to divestments and valuation adjustments.
kpis.signal: Reflects the total size of the investment portfolio

kpis.name: Dividend Paid
kpis.explanation: Amount distributed to shareholders during the year.
kpis.description: Dividend paid increased from 2.2 to 3.8 billion NOK in 2024, in line with an enhanced distribution policy.

kpis.name: Dividends and Repayments from Subsidiaries
kpis.explanation: Income received by Aker from its holdings.
kpis.description: Dividends and repayments from subsidiaries rose to 11.2 billion NOK in 2024, driven by Aker Solutions and Aker BP.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in cash flows from holdings

kpis.name: Liquidity Reserve
kpis.explanation: Cash available for new investments or opportunities.
kpis.description: Liquidity reserve increased to 8.4 billion NOK in 2024, up from 6.3 billion the prior year.
kpis.signal: Enhanced capacity to seize strategic opportunities

kpis.name: Share Price
kpis.explanation: Market value of Aker's share in NOK.
kpis.description: Share price declined to 549 NOK at end-2024, from 666 a year earlier, despite a 9% rise in the Oslo index.
kpis.signal: Underperformance vs index despite challenging macro backdrop

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 99.56 Bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 42.7 Bn € in latest year

kpis.name: Net Asset Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Net value attributable to each share, a key performance indicator.
kpis.description: NAV per share decreased from 851 to 783 NOK in 2024, reflecting pressure on portfolio valuations.

kpis.name: Total Portfolio Revenue
kpis.explanation: Combined revenue of companies where Aker is the largest shareholder.
kpis.description: Portfolio companies generated 209 billion NOK in revenue in 2024, with approximately 28,100 employees.
kpis.signal: Significant scale of the operational portfolio

risks.title: Exposure to oil and gas price volatility
risks.summary: Aker BP, the largest portfolio asset (45.3% of GAV), generates revenue from oil and gas exploration and production on the Norwegian continental shelf. The 2.9% decline in Brent prices in 2024 and global macroeconomic uncertainty directly impact valuation and dividends received (3.5 Bn NOK in 2024). Any prolonged drop in prices would significantly affect the group's NAV.
risks.score_rationale: Aker BP represents 45.3% of GAV (29.7 Bn NOK). The text highlights direct exposure to Brent prices (down 2.9% in 2024) and reliance on oil revenues. Strong language on the strategic importance of the E&P portfolio. Stable trend but major structural risk to group value.

risks.title: Project risks and cost overruns in major projects
risks.summary: Aker Solutions (9.2% of GAV) provides integrated solutions and engineering services to the global energy industry. The group emphasizes the importance of 'delivering the substantial order backlog safely, on time, and within budget'. Cost overruns or delays on major field development projects could erode EBITDA margins (8.7% in 2024).
risks.score_rationale: Aker Solutions holds a substantial order backlog including major field development projects. The text explicitly mentions the need to 'deliver on time and within budget'. Moderate language but significant operational risk for an engineering firm. Stable trend with focus on execution.

risks.title: Energy transition and obsolescence of the oil portfolio
risks.summary: Aker Horizons invests in renewable energy and green technologies but reported operating losses (-496 M NOK EBITDA in 2024). The global energy transition creates regulatory pressure on the traditional oil portfolio (Aker BP) while making green investments harder to profit from. Mainstream Renewable Power is restructuring, signaling profitability challenges in the sector.
risks.score_rationale: Aker Horizons (1.7% GAV) lost value (-0.9 Bn NOK in 2024). The text acknowledges 'growing need for safe, affordable, low-emission energy'. Moderate language but clear negative trend: Mainstream Renewable Power is reducing costs, ACC sold 80% to SLB. Major regulatory and energy transition risk.

risks.title: Litigation risks in restructuring processes
risks.summary: In May 2024, a claim was filed against Aker Capital (100% subsidiary of Aker ASA) and several other parties for alleged losses related to the refinancing of Solstad Offshore. The hearing is scheduled for autumn 2025. Although Aker Capital disputes the claim, the litigation could result in legal costs and affect the value of Solstad investments (combined 8.7% of GAV).
risks.score_rationale: Two litigations explicitly mentioned: (1) claim against Aker Capital and others for losses related to Solstad Offshore refinancing (hearing autumn 2025), (2) Aker Capital disputes the claim's validity. Factual language but identified legal risk. Stable trend but potential impact on Solstad value (8.7% GAV combined).

risks.title: Dependence on growth and profitability of industrial software
risks.summary: Cognite (industrial digitalization software) and Aize (digital twin) are high-growth, non-profitable technology investments. Cognite reported record ARR of 1 Bn NOK (+38%) but remains unprofitable (-62 M USD). Aize achieved 240% ARR growth and signed deals with BP and ExxonMobil, but is still loss-making (-21 M USD). Success depends on rapid monetization and achieving profitability before cash runs out.
risks.score_rationale: Cognite and Aize are key technology assets with rapid growth. Cognite: ARR +38% (1 Bn NOK), but net loss -62 M USD in 2024. Aize: ARR +240%, but net loss -21 M USD. Intense language on SaaS strategy and international expansion. 'Up' trend: rapid growth but profitability not achieved. Risk of cash burn and dilution.

risks.title: Operational and market risks in aquaculture and marine nutrition
risks.summary: Aker BioMarine (global krill leader) and Aker Qrill Company (Antarctic krill harvesting) operate in a sector exposed to raw material price volatility and demand for marine nutrition. BioMarine reported a net loss of -14 M USD in 2024 despite an 8.0% EBITDA margin. Recent restructuring (sale of Feed Ingredients business) creates integration risks and concentration in the health-nutrition segment.
risks.score_rationale: Aker BioMarine (7.0% GAV) and Aker Qrill Company (2.4% GAV) operate in marine nutrition. BioMarine: EBITDA margin 8.0%, net loss -14 M USD in 2024. Qrill Company: EBITDA margin -5.1%, net loss -21 M USD in 2024. Moderate language but negative trend: ongoing restructuring (Feed Ingredients sold to AIP). Risk of raw material price and demand volatility.

risks.title: Refinancing and capital structure risks in subsidiaries
risks.summary: Solstad Offshore refinanced its debt in 2024 with new loans from DNB and Eksportfinans, with Aker contributing 2.3 Bn NOK. Solstad Maritime plans an IPO in Q2 2025, with AMSC distributing 19.6% of shares to shareholders. These refinancing and restructuring activities create risks of dilution, market volatility, and dependence on credit conditions.
risks.score_rationale: Solstad Offshore refinanced its debt in 2024 (maturity March 2024) with new loans from DNB and Eksportfinans. Aker contributed 2.3 Bn NOK. Factual language on refinancing activities. Stable trend but recurring refinancing risk. Solstad Maritime plans IPO in Q2 2025, creating dilution and volatility risks.

risks.title: Portfolio concentration and valuation risk of major assets
risks.summary: Aker's portfolio is highly concentrated: Aker BP alone represents 45.3% of GAV, and the top five assets account for approximately 75% of total value. NAV decreased by 7.9% in 2024 (from 63.2 to 58.2 Bn NOK), reflecting broad valuation declines, notably at Aker BP (-9.9 Bn NOK) and Aker Solutions (-2.1 Bn NOK). This concentration creates a major systemic risk: any significant deterioration in major assets directly impacts group value.
risks.score_rationale: Aker BP alone represents 45.3% of GAV (29.7 Bn NOK). The top five assets (BP, Solutions, BioMarine, Horizons, Solstad) represent ~75% of GAV. NAV declined from 63.2 to 58.2 Bn NOK (-7.9%) in 2024. Intense language on portfolio dependence. Negative trend: broad value decline. Major systemic risk.

ai_positioning.summary: Aker does not position artificial intelligence as a central strategic pillar, but supports technology initiatives in its subsidiaries, particularly in energy and marine biotechnology.
evidence: Aker Solutions uses AI in offshore operations optimization
Aker BP invests in digital technology to reduce emissions
No direct mention of generative AI or cloud AI in reporting
